clauses.label: Revocation of the remainder of Executive Order No. 5341 land withdrawal
clauses.quote:
Executive Order No.  
5341, of May 2, 1930, withdrawing public  
lands in  Arizona pending a resurvey, and  
heretofore partially revoked, is hereby  
revoked as to the remainder o f the lands  
affected thereby.

clauses.quote:
T his order sh all become effective upon  
the date of th e official filing of the plat  
of the resurvey of the lands involved.
